description: This file defines the `Combinations` class in the `PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\\Calculation\\MathTrig` namespace. It provides methods to calculate combinations with and without repetition, used as functions in PHPExcel/PhpSpreadsheet for spreadsheet calculations involving combinatorics.

classes.name: Combinations
classes.description: A class providing static methods to compute combinations and arrangements related to combinatorics, usable as spreadsheet functions.

methods.name: withoutRepetition
methods.description: Calculates the number of combinations of a given number of objects without repetition, equivalent to the 'COMBIN' function in spreadsheets.

methods.name: withRepetition
methods.description: Calculates the number of combinations with repetition, similar to the 'COMBINA' function in spreadsheets.
